params.file_key: File key, or any figma.com link to the file (design, proto, board, branch). A link's node-id is used when node_ids is omitted.

file_get.description: Outline of a Figma file: pages and their frames by id, name and type, plus the file's components and shared styles. Start here to find the node ids nodes_get and images_render take. Geometry and styles are not included: use nodes_get for those.

params.depth: How deep to list: 1 = pages, 2 = top-level frames (default), up to 4.
params.library: Include component and style names (default true).

nodes_get.description: What building a screen takes, per node: box [x, y, w, h], auto-layout (mode, gap, padding, alignment), sizing, fills and strokes as hex, corner radius, effects, text and its font, and the names of the shared styles it uses. Children recurse to `depth`; deeper ones are counted.

params.node_ids: Node ids ("1:2" or "1-2"), up to 20. Defaults to the node-id of the link in file_key.
params.depth: Levels of children to describe: 0 to 6, default 3.

images_render.description: Render nodes to images through Figma. PNG and JPG come back inline so you can look at them (up to 4 per call); every format also returns Figma's URL. attach=true uploads the files to the task, where a person can see them.

params.node_ids: Node ids to render, up to 10. Defaults to the node-id of the link in file_key.
params.scale: 0.01 to 4, default 1. Use 2 for a sharp view of a small component.
params.inline: Return PNG/JPG inline (default true for those formats).
params.attach: Upload each render to this run's task as an attachment.

comments_list.description: Comments on a file grouped into threads, newest first, with the node each one is pinned to. Resolved threads are left out unless include_resolved is set.

team_projects_list.description: Projects of a Figma team. Figma has no endpoint that lists a person's teams: the team id comes from a link like figma.com/files/team/<id>.

params.team_id: Team id, or a figma.com link that contains /team/<id>.

project_files_list.description: Files of a Figma project, with their keys and last change.

errors.no_credential: no Thulu credential was forwarded with this call — the agent's key rides on the MCP handshake (X-API-Key); this server holds none of its own
errors.octopus_api_unset: OCTOPUS_API is not set on this server
errors.credential_not_figma: credential "{credential}" is a {provider} credential, not a Figma one
errors.no_figma_credential: no Figma token is available to this task. Add a Figma credential on the Credentials page and grant it to the workspace or to this task's project.
errors.image_download: downloading the render failed with HTTP {status}
errors.file_key_invalid: not a Figma file key or link: "{value}"
errors.node_ids_required: node_ids is required (or pass a link with ?node-id= as file_key)
errors.too_many_nodes: {count} node ids; at most {max} per call
errors.attach_without_task: attach needs a task, and this session is not tied to one
errors.team_id_invalid: not a team id or team link: "{value}"
errors.tool_not_allowed: tool '{name}' is not in the allowed tool list for this session
errors.tool_scope_required: tool '{name}' requires scope '{required}', this session has '{scope}'
errors.handshake_no_key: an MCP session needs the run's key on the handshake (X-API-Key or Authorization: Bearer)
errors.message_key_mismatch: this message does not carry the key its session was opened with
errors.list_only_session: this session was opened without a credential: it can list tools, not call them

text.truncated: […truncated: {bytes} more bytes omitted by thulu-figma. Ask for less: a lower depth, fewer node ids.]
text.render_empty: Figma returned no image for this node (invisible, empty, or not renderable)
text.inline_too_large: {bytes} bytes, over the {max}-byte inline cap: lower the scale, or use attach
text.render_urls_expire: Figma's image URLs expire after 30 days; attach the ones the task should keep.
